comments.oracle_client_lib_dir: Oracle Instant Client 11.2 directory for thick mode.

comments.sms_userport: SMS business port written into yfgadb.dfsdl.userport.
comments.sms_mobiles: Optional fixed mobile list used as fallback or extra recipients.
comments.dedup_hours: Deduplication window in hours for the same eid and mobile.
comments.dxpt_start_date: Start date used to replace the hard-coded SQL date, format YYYY-MM-DD.
comments.dry_run: Set true to test the task without sending real SMS.

comments.disable_sms: Disable SMS sending for this data import task.
comments.multi_mode: Write mode: append for upsert, replace for full truncate and reload.
comments.multi_login_url: Login endpoint used to obtain the session cookie.
comments.multi_login_username: Login username for the source system.
comments.multi_login_password: Login password for the source system.
comments.multi_api_url_duty: Duty schedule API endpoint to fetch source data.
comments.multi_db_sslmode: Kingbase SSL mode, usually disable in the intranet.
comments.multi_begin_days_ago: Start offset in days before today for scheduleDate generation.
comments.multi_end_days_ago: End offset in days before today for scheduleDate generation.
comments.multi_request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for each request.
comments.data_multi_task_enabled: Enable or disable all built-in sub tasks.

comments.disable_sms: Disable SMS sending for this data collection task.
comments.zq_login_url: Login endpoint for the dsjfx source system.
comments.zq_login_username: Login username for the dsjfx source system.
comments.zq_login_password: Login password for the dsjfx source system.
comments.zq_api_url: Case list API endpoint for source data collection.
comments.zq_begin_days_ago: Number of days before today used as the query start date.
comments.zq_page_size: Page size sent to the source API.
comments.zq_page_num: Page number sent to the source API.
